meta.title: Lumirift Blocks — the falling-blocks game, reinvented
meta.description: The falling-blocks game reinvented: brand-new modes, a daily challenge, shattering crystal. Free, no sign-up, on mobile and desktop.

app.name: Lumirift Blocks
app.tagline: The rules you know. Games you have never played.
app.privacy: No account, no tracking: your records stay on your device.
app.privacyPortal: No account, no tracking: the platform you play on keeps your progress.

home.quick: A game of Classic, right now

reel.elements: Lightning, fire, seeds: the sand reacts
reel.flip: Turn the well over: the holes vanish
reel.duneWorm: It bursts out of the sand
reel.ceramicGolem: It hurls stones at your mosaic
reel.mirror: The well becomes its own reflection
reel.towerEye: Blind it in its glass tower
reel.riftHeart: Strike its heart with your lines

daily.title: Daily Challenge
daily.rules: Two minutes, the same pieces for everyone.

classic.name: Classic
classic.pitch: The reference: a little faster every 10 lines.

tide.name: Tide
tide.pitch: Rows rise from the bottom, faster and faster. Hold on.

flip.name: Flip
flip.pitch: Turn the well upside down: the stack falls back and holes vanish.

chroma.name: Chroma
chroma.pitch: A line of a single colour is worth four times as much.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.pitch: Every 10 lines, the well is mirrored. Adapt.

fusion.name: Fusion
fusion.pitch: Six blocks of one colour fuse: set off chain reactions.

tilt.name: Tilt
tilt.pitch: Every 10 lines the well turns: the left wall becomes the floor.

silhouette.name: Silhouette
silhouette.pitch: A puzzle a day: fill the shape with a limited number of pieces.

rhythm.name: Rhythm
rhythm.pitch: Land your pieces on the beat to multiply your points.

duel.name: Duel
duel.pitch: Face an AI: every line you clear sends rows to your opponent.

mosaic.name: Mosaic
mosaic.pitch: Place ceramic pieces, complete rows and columns, earn jokers.

sand.name: Sand
sand.pitch: Pieces crumble into grains: link both walls with a single colour.

tower.name: Tower
tower.pitch: The well rolls into a glass cylinder: a line goes all the way round.

notice.mirrorSoon: The well is about to be mirrored
notice.tiltSoon: The well is about to tilt
notice.burn: Fire burnt {value} grain | Fire burnt {value} grains
notice.elementOil: Oil piece: it floats, and fire makes it blaze
notice.elementIce: Ice piece: it holds, freezes water, melts in fire
notice.elementLightning: Lightning: aim at water for a shock
notice.elementSeed: Seed: water it to grow a bridge of its colour
notice.elementAcid: Acid: it eats the sand under it

strike.shock: Shock! {value} grain broken through the water | Shock! {value} grains broken through the water
strike.shatter: Lightning: {value} grain shattered | Lightning: {value} grains shattered
strike.fuse: Lightning sets the vine on fire

notice.bombPiece: Bomb gem: clear its ring to blow up the tower around it
notice.blast: Boom! {value} block blown away | Boom! {value} blocks blown away

boss.warn: Red cracks: the Dune Wyrm is coming up there!
boss.exposed: Its head is out: strike it!
boss.swallow: It swallows the sand at the surface!
boss.stunned: Shocked through the water: it is stunned!
boss.critical: Lightning on its head: critical hit!

golem.aim: The Golem aims at the glowing cells: stones will land there!
golem.throw: Stones! One line cracks them, a second breaks them.
golem.parry: Parry: filling an aimed cell blocks its stone!
golem.shatter: Its own stones broken hurt it!
golem.phase2: The Golem cracks: it throws more stones!

eye.charge: The Eye stops and turns red: it will strike under its gaze!
eye.strike: Stones fall where it was looking!
eye.blinded: A bomb in its gaze: the Eye is blinded!
eye.rubble: It raises a ring of rubble!
eye.phase2: The Eye grows angry: its gaze widens!
eye.defeated: The Eye of the Tower is defeated!

heart.swell: The Heart swells: rubble will rise, its holes glow on the floor!
heart.shard: Each row of rubble holds a shard of the rift: clear it!
heart.wounded: Shard cleared: the Heart is struck deep!
heart.mirror: The rift bends the rules: the well turns at each beat!
heart.phase2: The Heart races: it beats faster!
heart.phase3: Last stand: the rift tears open!
heart.defeated: The Heart of the Rift is defeated!

controls.label: Touch controls
controls.touch: Touch: swipe to move, tap to rotate, swipe down fast for a hard drop.

over.title: Game over
over.doubleXpLabel: Watch an ad to double this game’s experience (+{n} XP)
over.noAd: No ad available right now. Try again after another game.

settings.title: Settings
settings.controlsHint: On a touch screen, the buttons come back under the well.

duelHint.rookie: Slow, still learning the game, often wrong.
duelHint.normal: Solid: it holds pieces and builds up its attacks.
duelHint.hard: Fast, it plans for the next piece and rarely errs.
duelHint.expert: As good as the best players: it never errs.

mosaic.noJoker: Clear several lines at once to earn jokers.
mosaic.helpTouch: Touch: drag a piece onto the board, or tap it then tap a cell.

sand.helpTouch: Touch: swipe to move, tap to rotate, swipe down fast for a hard drop. Link one colour from wall to wall. Elements react: oil feeds fire, fire melts ice into steam, lightning through water breaks everything it touches, watered seeds grow bridges.

tower.helpTouch: Touch: swipe to move, tap to rotate, swipe down fast for a hard drop, drag with two fingers to turn the tower. The camera follows the piece.

profile.objectivesNote: New objectives every day at midnight.

objectives.duel: Beat the normal AI or a stronger one

progress.title: Progress
progress.tooShort: Play for at least 20 seconds to earn experience.
